Post-Test Survey Instructions
Example Program Resource Center

Thank you for taking part in the example classroom program. Please complete the survey within one week of the final session so the team can compare it with the survey you took before the program began.

How to complete the survey
1. Open the survey link your teacher shared.
2. Enter the class code printed on the handout.
3. Answer every question. There are no right or wrong answers.

If a question makes you uncomfortable, you may skip it. Your answers are combined with everyone else's and are never reported by name.

Contact
Questions about the survey go to the program office through the contact form on the resource center site.
